#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iomanip>

const int MOD = 998244353;

std::vector<int> multiply(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int required = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < required) size <<= 1;

    std::vector<double> ra(size, 0.0), ia(size, 0.0);
    std::vector<double> rb(size, 0.0), ib(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        long long val = a[i] % mod;
        if (val < 0) val += mod;
        ra[i] = static_cast<double>(val & 0x7fff);
        ia[i] = static_cast<double>(val >> 15);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
        long long val = b[i] % mod;
        if (val < 0) val += mod;
        rb[i] = static_cast<double>(val & 0x7fff);
        ib[i] = static_cast<double>(val >> 15);
    }

    // FFT
    auto fft = [](std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
        int n = re.size();
        int bits = 0;
        int temp = n - 1;
        while (temp > 0) {
            bits++;
            temp >>= 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int rev = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < bits; j++) {
                if (i & (1 << j)) {
                    rev |= 1 << (bits - 1 - j);
                }
            }
            if (i < rev) {
                std::swap(re[i], re[rev]);
                std::swap(im[i], im[rev]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            double ang = 2 * M_PI / len * (inv ? -1 : 1);
            double wlenRe = cos(ang);
            double wlenIm = sin(ang);

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                double wRe = 1.0, wIm = 0.0;
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double uRe = re[i + j], uIm = im[i + j];
                    double vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm;
                    double vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe;

                    re[i + j] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[i + j] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm;

                    double tmp = wRe * wlenRe - wIm * wlenIm;
                    wIm = wRe * wlenIm + wIm * wlenRe;
                    wRe = tmp;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    };

    fft(ra, ia, false);
    fft(rb, ib, false);

    std::vector<double> resR(size, 0.0), resI(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        double a1r = (ra[i] + ra[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (ia[i] - ia[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (ia[i] + ia[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (ra[j] - ra[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (rb[i] + rb[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (ib[i] - ib[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (ib[i] + ib[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (rb[j] - rb[i]) * 0.5;

        resR[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resI[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
    }

    fft(resR, resI, true);

    std::vector<int> result(required);
    for (int i = 0; i < required; i++) {
        long long val = llround(resR[i]);
        long long val2 = llround(resI[i]);
        long long combined = (val + (val2 << 15)) % mod;
        result[i] = static_cast<int>(combined);
    }
    return result;
}

class InputReader {
private:
    std::istream& in;

public:
    InputReader(std::istream& stream) : in(stream) {}

    int readInt() {
        int c;
        while ((c = in.get()) <= ' ') {
            if (in.eof()) throw std::runtime_error("Unexpected EOF");
        }
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = in.get();
        }
        int num = 0;
        while (c > ' ') {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("NumberFormatException");
            num = num * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = in.get();
        }
        return num * sign;
    }
};

class OutputWriter {
private:
    std::ostream& out;

public:
    OutputWriter(std::ostream& stream) : out(stream) {}

    void printLine(long long value) {
        out << value << '\n';
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    OutputWriter out(std::cout);

    int n = in.readInt();
    int k = in.readInt();
    std::vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx = in.readInt();
        if (idx >= 0 && idx < 10) {
            poly[idx] = 1;
        }
    }

    std::vector<int> res = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;

    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            res = multiply(res, poly, MOD);
        }
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }

    long long sum = 0;
    for (int c : res) {
        sum = (sum + static_cast<long long>(c) * c) % MOD;
    }
    out.printLine(sum);

    return 0;
}
